title: Tunisian Lentil Wrap
description: A flavorful and nutritious wrap filled with Tunisian-spiced lentils, topped with fresh vegetables. Perfect for a quick and easy lunch or dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the carrots and cook for another 5 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Add the lentils, Tunisian spice blend, salt, and pepper. Cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add 2 cups of water to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
While the lentils are cooking, slice the cucumber, tomato, and parsley.
Warm the wrap in the microwave or in a dry pan for a few seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spooning the lentil mixture onto the center of the wrap, then topping with the sliced vegetables.
